event: ID666 (Shikhov ESSD 2020), squall 29.07-02.08.2017, north Sverdlovsk oblast, 950 ha / 553 polygons
pipeline: plugin v0.8.0 WindthrowDetector on 6 S1B IW RTC scenes (PC COG, parallel windowed copy), grid 5245x5108 (3 km buffer), bg sample = ring minus polygons
reference: PA/UA object-based, 8-conn components, TP at >=30% overlap; 524 ref components
findings: F1 WET SHIFT CONFIRMED: post 03.08 vs base 22.07 whole-AOI means +0.92 dB (VV) / +1.24 dB (VH); forest-bg median offsets +1.18/+1.56 dB; 10.07 also wet (+0.6..0.8 dB)

F2 ADAPTIVE-THRESHOLD INVARIANCE (negative result): adaptive mode (mean_bg + a) is mathematically invariant to uniform additive normalization - pair+norm+adaptive gave pixel-identical output to no-norm (archived windthrow_id666_B_adaptive_invariant.json). Normalization is meaningful only for FIXED-threshold (monitoring) mode

F3 NO POSITIVE WINDTHROW SIGNAL IN LEAF-ON C-BAND FOR THIS EVENT: WI median inside reference is ~1 dB BELOW the forest-proxy ring median (wet pair -1.03 dB, dry pair -0.99 dB). Forest background rises +3..+4 dB (soil moisture + phenology) while damaged stands rise less. WI=deltaVV+deltaVH with x+a thresholding cannot detect ID666 in leaf-on summer regardless of tuning
F4 FALSE ALARMS ARE DOMINATED BY NON-FOREST (UA 0.015-0.023, thousands of objects over fields/harvest): forest mask (v0.9) is mandatory for any operational use
F5 STACK HELPS MODESTLY: 3-pre median composite reduces flagged area ~20-25% (7335 vs 9506 wet; 7131 vs 9238 dry) and slightly raises UA

F6 INFRASTRUCTURE WORKS: full chain PC STAC -> COG windowed copy (55 s/band, 4 threads) -> detect (11-27 s) -> object metrics; wet-shift signature, orbit set (rel orbit 94: 6070/6245/6420/6595/6770/6945), masks and metrics all reproducible from the manifest
next_steps: 1. Forest mask for bg sample AND detection restriction (v0.9, GWL_FCS30 or PALSAR FNF)
2. Leaf-off test: repeat detection on an October-April event from the DB (the index physics differs without canopy)
3. Index study on ID666: dVH-only, VH/VV ratio, log-ratio, longer post window (+1..+28 d)
5. Keep v0.8 normalization for fixed-threshold mode; document invariance in METHOD.md
